newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone buys rest of Astec Communications.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone buys rest of Astec Communications.

text.p: Vodafone Group Plc, Britain's biggest mobile phones firm, said on Tuesday that it has acquired the remaining 80 percent stake in Astec Communications it did not already hold.
The company said in a statement that it exercised its right to convert loans from Vodafone to Astec to equity.
Astec is a service provider to more than 97,000 mobile telephone subscribers, the majority being connected to the Vodafone network, and has a chain of 21 retail outlets.
Vodafone said that Astec will continue to operate as a separate business within the Vodafone Group for the immediate future.
